topic: How Multilayer Perceptrons (MLP) Store Facts in Transformers

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Transformer Architecture Anatomy
lecture_lines: Transformers consist of Attention and MLP blocks.
Attention manages context, like a reading desk.
MLP blocks serve as long-term memory.
animations: Show Transformer block diagram with highlights on MLP layers using #3498DB.
Zoom into MLP sub-layer showing hidden layers. Label layers #E74C3C.
Display weight matrices W1 and W2 in #2ECC71.

sections.title: The MLP as a Key-Value Associative Memory
lecture_lines: MLP layers are key-value associative memories.
First layer acts as a pattern matcher.
Second layer retrieves specific fact outputs.
animations: Display input vector with query. Highlight with #3498DB.
Show matrix multiplication as key look-up. Label #E74C3C.
Display output vector as retrieved value. Highlight with #2ECC71.

sections.title: Mathematical Visualization: The Weights as a Database
lecture_lines: Weights act as a high-dimensional database.
This illumination retrieves stored factual information.
animations: Visualize weight matrices as rows/columns. Label with #3498DB.
Show projection mapping input space to storage. Color #E74C3C.
Demonstrate retrieval with vector-matrix dot product. Use #2ECC71.

sections.title: Case Study: Fact Editing and Activation
lecture_lines: Specific neurons encode individual factual knowledge.
Training adjusts weights to update associations.
We can suppress or excite specific facts.
animations: Overlay specific fact-related activation heatmaps. Highlight #3498DB.
Show weight modification effect on retrieval. Label #E74C3C.
Animate final output change showing fact update. Use #2ECC71.

sections.title: Synthesis and Summary
lecture_lines: Attention handles context; MLPs store facts.
Facts are distributed across weight patterns.
Together, they form an intelligent system.
animations: Review MLP as key-value memory concept. Color #3498DB.
Flash key mechanisms: matrix look-up and projection. #E74C3C.
Show final takeaway on knowledge storage. Highlight #2ECC71.
